provenance.description: Example grounded source material for a 'Roman Empire' hyper-masculine hero portrait study. Shot specifically to feed AI concept work with full EXIF + notes. This is the real photo the later AI builds off (or ghosts over).

location.name: Griffith Observatory overlook, Los Angeles
location.notes: Clear dawn light, distant city + hills. Used as stand-in for 'steps of an ancient Roman temple' + 'imperial cityscape' in prompt.

subject.name: Alex R. (model release on file)
subject.notes: Athletic build, strong bone structure. Briefed on 'roman carving' heroic stillness. Wore simple black tank + light oil for skin specularity.

film_stock_emulation.notes: Digital capture but shot + lit + post-intended to match Portra 400 creamy skin + delicate grain. Later used Cinestill 800T for night variants.

lighting.description: Low sun from camera-left (dawn), large white foam board bounce from right for fill. No strobes. Wanted long sculpted shadows for jaw/cheekbone drama.
lighting.notes: Golden rim on left side of face/neck/traps. Deep but transparent shadows on right. Matches 'dramatic shadows, increased jaw size' direction.

photo_shoot.direction_notes: Profile-ish three-quarter, gaze off to 'empire' (horizon + city). Chin slightly lifted. Shoulders back. Heroic but not smiling. 8 frames selected for 'still from 1972 sword-and-sandal epic'.
